note: BH-9944. 1 (default): for each open PR the design-collision check reads the PR's patch and the head content of the files it touches one time, and runs the per-symbol git reads only for a symbol whose name is in that text. The COLLISION rows are the same. 0|false|no|off: the old loop, every symbol against every PR (2 to 6 hours at 40 symbols and 51 PRs). Any other value is treated as ON.
